backtest.yml.text:
name: backtest-v2

# Hebdomadaire : dimanche 03:00 UTC. Fenêtre calme (0 run refresh-data
# concurrents sur cette minute → pas de conflit de push). Durée ~1-3 min
# selon la taille de odds_history.jsonl.
#
# Ce workflow évalue la VRAIE fonction predictMatch (depuis pronostics.html)
# via mini-racer — pas une baseline de marché, pas une duplication Python.
# Une seule source de vérité : pronostics.html.
#
# Le rapport (backtest_report_v2.{json,md}) est committé dans le repo pour
# que Théo puisse le lire directement sur GitHub/GH Pages.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  backtest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: backtest-v2
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install deps
        # mini-racer = V8 embarqué pour appeler predictMatch depuis Python.
        # --break-system-packages : pattern déjà utilisé par refresh.yml
        # sur l'image ubuntu-latest (Python managé par apt).
        run: pip install mini-racer --break-system-packages

      - name: Run backtest v2
        run: python3 scripts/backtest_v2.py

      - name: Commit report
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add backtest_report_v2.json backtest_report_v2.md 2>/dev/null || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to backtest report — skipping commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "backtest: weekly v2 refresh $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d UTC')"
          git push

e2e.yml.text:
name: e2e-tests

# Run Playwright critical-flow tests on PRs and pushes to main.
# Catches regressions in nav/theme/filter bar before they ship to GH Pages.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pronostics.html'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'playwright.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pronostics.html'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'playwright.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Playwright + browsers
        run: |
          npm ci || npm install
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: npx playwright test --project=chromium-desktop

      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

lighthouse.yml.text:
name: lighthouse

# Tracking continu de la perf web — runs Lighthouse contre une instance
# python http.server qui sert pronostics.html. Catch les régressions FCP/
# LCP/TBT/CLS avant qu'elles n'arrivent en prod.
#
# Déclenché sur push qui touche le HTML/sw/data, et manuellement.
# Pas en cron (Lighthouse est sensible aux variations réseau et on n'a
# pas besoin de scores quotidiens).

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pronostics.html'
      - 'sw.js'
      - 'manifest.webmanifest'
      - 'index.html'
      - '.github/workflows/lighthouse.yml'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: lighthouse-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Lighthouse CLI
        run: npm install --no-save lighthouse@12 chrome-launcher

      - name: Start static server
        run: |
          python -m http.server 8765 &
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            sleep 1
            if curl -fsS http://localhost:8765/pronostics.html -o /dev/null; then break; fi
          done

      - name: Run Lighthouse
        run: |
          npx lighthouse http://localhost:8765/pronostics.html \
            --output=json --output=html \
            --output-path=./lighthouse \
            --chrome-flags="--headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu" \
            --only-categories=performance,accessibility,best-practices,seo \
            --quiet

      - name: Print scores
        run: |
          node -e '
            const r = require("./lighthouse.report.json");
            const cats = r.categories;
            const fmt = c => ((c.score || 0) * 100).toFixed(0).padStart(3) + "/100";
            console.log("=== Lighthouse scores ===");
            console.log("Performance     :", fmt(cats.performance));
            console.log("Accessibility   :", fmt(cats.accessibility));
            console.log("Best practices  :", fmt(cats["best-practices"]));
            console.log("SEO             :", fmt(cats.seo));
            console.log("");
            const audits = r.audits;
            const m = (id) => audits[id] && audits[id].displayValue ? audits[id].displayValue : "-";
            console.log("FCP (1st paint)  :", m("first-contentful-paint"));
            console.log("LCP (largest)    :", m("largest-contentful-paint"));
            console.log("TBT (blocking)   :", m("total-blocking-time"));
            console.log("CLS (layout)     :", m("cumulative-layout-shift"));
            console.log("Speed Index      :", m("speed-index"));
            console.log("Total weight     :", m("total-byte-weight"));
            console.log("Unused JS        :", m("unused-javascript"));
          '

      - name: Upload report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lighthouse-report
          path: |
            lighthouse.report.html
            lighthouse.report.json
          retention-days: 30

refresh.yml.text:
name: refresh-data

# Re-run every 5 minutes during active hours (10-23 UTC), every 30 minutes
# overnight (0-9 UTC). Reduces ~75% of CI minutes and commit noise during
# hours where few matches are live. Matches the site's prime-time window
# (late afternoon → late night Europe / daytime Americas).
# Client-side 60s poll + visibilitychange refresh keep the UX fresh.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 10-23 * * *'    # day: every 5 min
    - cron: '*/30 0-9 * * *'     # night: every 30 min
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: refresh-data
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install deps
        run: pip install curl_cffi --break-system-packages

      - name: Run fetch pipeline
        run: |
          set -e
          cd scripts
          python3 fetch_live.py || true      # today only, ~15s
          python3 patch_odds.py || true      # normalize ESPN odds
          python3 fetch_tennis_odds.py || true
          python3 fetch_rus_odds.py || true
          python3 fetch_injuries.py || true  # ESPN: US sports (NBA/NHL/NFL/MLB)
          python3 fetch_h2h.py || true       # head-to-head histories
          python3 snapshot_odds.py || true   # freeze pre-match odds (persist post-match for bilan)
          python3 snapshot_results.py || true # archive completed matches into results_archive.jsonl (long backtest window)
          python3 fetch_forebet.py || true   # cheap: single HTML page, 40+ preds over 3 days
          # Every 3rd tick (= 15 min), also refresh RdJ tipsters (10 HTTP reqs, respectful cadence)
          MIN_MOD15=$(( $(date +%M) % 15 ))
          if [ $MIN_MOD15 -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_tips.py || true
          fi
          # Sofascore soccer injuries: slow (~85s), so only every 2h. The per-run
          # patch step below re-attaches the cached data in <1s on every tick.
          HOUR_MOD2=$(( $(date +%H) % 2 ))
          if [ $HOUR_MOD2 -eq 0 ] && [ $MIN_MOD15 -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_injuries_soccer.py || true
          fi
          # Sofascore soccer lineups: same cadence as injuries (same endpoint,
          # same rate-limit budget). Lineups lock ~1h before kickoff, so
          # refreshing every 2h captures the pre-match reveal window.
          if [ $HOUR_MOD2 -eq 0 ] && [ $MIN_MOD15 -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_lineups_soccer.py || true
          fi
          # Every 12th tick (= 1h), also run full ESPN sweep + Winamax catalog
          # so tomorrow+ stays fresh. Catalog scrape is slow (~1min) so it's
          # also on the hourly cadence.
          # v28 — Winamax index scrape : en une seule requete, produit a la fois
          # winamax_catalog.json (tournois + matchs) ET winamax_markets.json
          # (1N2 odds par match). Tres rapide (~2s) donc on le lance a chaque tick.
          python3 fetch_winamax_catalog.py || true
          if [ $(( $(date +%M) % 60 )) -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_v3.py || true
          fi
          # Team-stats (last-5 goal/form enrichies): slow (~4min for 334 teams),
          # run on 4h cadence. Team form changes at most once per match day so
          # this is plenty fresh.
          HOUR_MOD4=$(( $(date +%H) % 4 ))
          if [ $HOUR_MOD4 -eq 0 ] && [ $MIN_MOD15 -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_team_stats.py || true
          fi
          # ClubElo: single-call CSV fetch, self-throttles to 1 call / 20h so
          # safe to invoke on every tick. Cheap (<100 KB, <1s).
          python3 fetch_clubelo.py || true
          # Weather (Open-Meteo): free, no key. Script self-throttles — skips
          # if forecast <30min old OR kickoff >6h away. Typical run: <5s.
          python3 fetch_weather.py || true
          # Soccer referees (Sofascore): self-throttles to 1 call / 6h.
          # Per-fixture event lookup, respectful cadence (0.3s between).
          python3 fetch_referees_soccer.py || true
          # v30 — Recent W/L form for NBA/WNBA/NHL/MLB/NFL (ESPN doesnt
          # ship .form for these sports natively). Self-throttled 6h.
          if [ $(( $(date +%M) % 30 )) -lt 5 ]; then
            python3 fetch_team_form.py || true
          fi
          python3 patch_winamax.py || true
          # v28 — Patch multi-market odds (uses ev.winamax.match_id from patch_winamax).
          # Must run AFTER patch_winamax, BEFORE other patches that rewrite data.js.
          python3 patch_winamax_markets.py || true
          # Patch soccer injuries AFTER patch_winamax so they survive the
          # dedup/bucketing rewrite. Idempotent, ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_injuries_soccer.py || true
          # Patch team-stats AFTER patch_winamax for same reason (survives
          # competitor dedup). ~0.3s.
          python3 patch_team_stats.py || true
          # Patch lineups AFTER patch_winamax for same reason. ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_lineups_soccer.py || true
          # Patch ClubElo ratings last (survives all prior rewrites). ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_clubelo.py || true
          # Patch weather (survives all prior rewrites). Adds ev.weather to
          # football events with a fresh forecast. ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_weather.py || true
          # Patch referees last (survives all prior rewrites). Adds
          # ev.referee to each top-5 soccer event. ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_referees_soccer.py || true
          # v30 — Inject team_form.json (last 5 W/L) into competitor.form
          # for NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL events. Idempotent, ~0.1s.
          python3 patch_team_form.py || true
          # Build health.json — compact pipeline status snapshot. Visible at
          # https://harotensnor.github.io/paris-sportif/health.json so we can
          # spot stale/missing sources without scraping the workflow logs.
          python3 build_health.py || true
          # Chantier #3 lazy-load — DOIT tourner en DERNIER. Lit data.js (full),
          # écrit data_today.json + data_manifest.json + ré-inline LITE blob
          # dans pronostics.html. Réduit le 1er paint de ~1.4 MB à ~0.4 MB.
          python3 finalize_inline.py || true

      - name: Stamp sw.js CACHE_VERSION
        # Bumps the service worker cache key on every deploy, so browsers fetch
        # the fresh pronostics.html + data.js instead of serving stale cache.
        # Only stamped when other files actually changed (see next step).
        run: |
          BUILD_ID=$(date -u +'%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')
          sed -i "s|^const CACHE_VERSION = .*|const CACHE_VERSION = 'paris-sportif-${BUILD_ID}';|" sw.js

      - name: Commit data updates
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data.js pronostics.html odds_history.jsonl \
                  injuries_soccer.json winamax_catalog.json winamax_markets.json team_stats.json \
                  lineups_soccer.json clubelo.json weather.json \
                  weather_geo_cache.json referees_soccer.json health.json \
                  data_today.json data_manifest.json team_form.json \
                  results_archive.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
          # Only stamp sw.js if we have real content changes — otherwise
          # discard the version bump to avoid 288 empty commits/day.
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git checkout -- sw.js
            echo "No content changes — sw.js stamp reverted."
            exit 0
          fi
          git add sw.js
          git commit -m "data: auto-refresh $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')"
          # Retry on race conditions: when a manual push or another cron run
          # advances main between checkout and push, naive `git push` hits
          # non-fast-forward. Pull --rebase the autostash and retry up to 3x.
          # `git pull` works with fetch-depth: 1 because we only need to
          # rebase a handful of commits ahead.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if git push; then
              echo "Push succeeded on attempt $attempt."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Push rejected (attempt $attempt) — pulling --rebase and retrying."
            git pull --rebase --autostash origin main
          done
          echo "Push still failing after 3 retries — surfacing as a job failure."
          exit 1

smoke.yml.text:
name: smoke-e2e

# Fait tourner un headless Chromium sur chaque push vers main (et chaque PR),
# ouvre pronostics.html, clique toutes les pages et capte les erreurs JS.
# Bloque les régressions type TDZ avant qu'elles n'arrivent en prod.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pronostics.html'
      - 'sw.js'
      - 'scripts/smoke_e2e.js'
      - '.github/workflows/smoke.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pronostics.html'
      - 'sw.js'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  group: smoke-e2e-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install playwright
        run: |
          npm init -y
          npm install --no-save playwright@1

      - name: Install chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run smoke
        run: node scripts/smoke_e2e.js
